INSERT INTO soc_events (incident_id, ts, source, idem_key, src_ip, dst_ip, host, username, rule_id, rule_level, outcome, raw)
VALUES ('{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.incident_id }}', TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.timestamp }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.source }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.idem_key }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.src_ip }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.dst_ip }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.agent_name }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.dst_user }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.rule_id }}', {{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.rule_level }}, '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.outcome }}', convert_from(decode('{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.raw_b64 }}', 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb) ON CONFLICT (idem_key) DO NOTHING;

SELECT incident_id, ts, source, src_ip, dst_ip, host, username, rule_id, outcome FROM soc_events
WHERE ts > (TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.timestamp }}' - INTERVAL '24 hours') AND ts <= TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.timestamp }}'
AND (src_ip = '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.src_ip }}' OR host = '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.agent_name }}' OR username = '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.dst_user }}')
ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;

INSERT INTO soc_events (incident_id, ts, source, idem_key, src_ip, dst_ip, host, username, rule_id, rule_level, outcome, raw, parent_incident_id)
VALUES ('{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.incident_id }}', TIMESTAMPTZ '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.timestamp }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.source }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.idem_key }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.src_ip }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.dst_ip }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.agent_name }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.dst_user }}', '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.rule_id }}', {{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.rule_level }}, '{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.outcome }}', convert_from(decode('{{ $('NormalizeAlert').first().json.raw_b64 }}', 'base64'), 'UTF8')::jsonb, '{{ $('DedupCheck').first().json.incident_id }}') ON CONFLICT (idem_key) DO NOTHING;
UPDATE incidents SET event_count = event_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE incident_id = '{{ $('DedupCheck').first().json.incident_id }}';
